scope: Six-second, contact-free rollouts at 20 ms per step from clamped rest. 12 fresh cloth and 12 fresh cable scenes each have an original load schedule and a matched second-load variant.
protocol: The model advances one shared GRU from the current load, static geometry and material parameters. The input includes the load being applied at the current interval. Test prefixes are required to match bit for bit until the load changes.

training.standard_only: 224 single-load trajectories per material and native-coordinate supervision
training.updated: 224 single-load and 128 additional second-load trajectories per material, with the same objective and 6500-update budget as standard-only

selection.selection: Select a single low-latency checkpoint for both materials. Additional updates and phase inputs differ by less than 0.01 percentage points on development. Retain the earlier, unchanged recurrent architecture.
